title: Story arc detail: adapt Go arc/chapter contract and stop locking chapters when progress is not tracked

spec.problem: Clicking an arc on prod shows 'Arc not found': the Go /api/story/arcs/{slug} returns a flat arc with storyPayload and minimal chapters, but the page expects {arc,chapters,npcRelations,npcs} and also locks every chapter after the first because completedChapters is always 0

acceptance.text: storyArcDetail() adapts the flat Go detail (storyPayload synopsisVi/npcSlugs/artAccent, chapters with displayOrder/isBoss/estimatedMinutes) into {arc,chapters,npcRelations:[],npcs:[]} with arc.status active, totalChapters = number of chapters, bossChapterId = the boss chapter id, progressTracked false, and each chapter keeping id, slug, titles, displayOrder, isBoss, estimatedMinutes with empty briefing and scenarios
storyArcs() uses synopsisVi, npcSlugs and artAccent when the list provides them and keeps neutral defaults otherwise

ArcDetailClient shows every chapter as an enabled link to /{locale}/story/chapters/{id} when arc.progressTracked is false, and keeps the existing locked/done behaviour when progress is tracked or the flag is absent

spec.expected_behavior: The arc page renders the arc header, synopsis and all chapters from the Go API; chapters link to the chapter player; chapters are locked or marked done only when server-side progress is actually tracked
spec.observed_behavior: storyArcDetail() returns the flat Go object; detail.arc is undefined so the page renders Arc not found; even adapted, completedChapters 0 would lock chapters 2-4
spec.rollback_plan: Revert the commit; arc cards link to a page that says Arc not found, no data is affected

red_targets.test: storyArcDetail API adapter > adapts the flat Go arc detail into the page model and marks progress as not tracked
storyArcDetail API adapter > tolerates a missing storyPayload and chapters without optional fields
storyArcs catalogue fields > uses synopsisVi, npcSlugs and artAccent from the list when the backend provides them
ArcDetailClient > links every chapter when the server does not track progress
